name: Huízhuǎn Huīgūniang
source:
A classmate from next door was gone. The exact day was unclear – yesterday or the day before. It seemed trivial, yet a shiver lingered in the back of my mind.

I, Yui Hayagumo, tried to push it aside. Tomorrow, we would visit Haeming Hall, far from the familiar streets. The ruins promised adventure, but something about them felt… unsettled.

[From [url=https://sagisawayukiho.itch.io/renew-cinderella]Itch.io[/url]]
